def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for comp in blocks(g):
        rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        if r1-r0 >= c1-c0: # vertical block -> horizontal line above/below
            if r0>0 and any(g[r0-1][cc]==5 for cc in range(W)): r=r0-1
            else: r=r1+1
            lcols=[cc for cc in range(W) if g[r][cc]==5]; a,b=min(lcols),max(lcols)
            bl=c1-c0+1
            for cc in range(a,b+1):
                src=c0+((cc-c0)%bl)
                for rr in range(r0,r1+1):
                    g[rr][cc]=g[rr][src]
        else: # horizontal block -> vertical line
            if c0>0 and any(g[r][c0-1]==5 for r in range(H)): c=c0-1
            else: c=c1+1
            lrows=[rr for rr in range(H) if g[rr][c]==5]; a,b=min(lrows),max(lrows)
            bl=r1-r0+1
            for rr in range(a,b+1):
                src=r0+((rr-r0)%bl)
                for cc in range(c0,c1+1):
                    g[rr][cc]=g[src][cc]
    return g
